name: Magic Valley Equipment
description: Established 1985 in Paul Idaho. Magic Valley Equipment is known as one of the largest sugar beet equipment and parts dealers in the Western United States. Specializing in sugar beets, but also offering equipment and parts for many other agricultural needs such as; potatoes, hay, tillage, grain, planting and many more.  As a shortline dealer, we have access to many vendors and distributors.  If there is something you are in need of and we don't have it, generally we can find it.  We also have a full service shop for your repair or rebuild needs.

name: Mainca Usa Inc.
description: Mainca USA was founded in 2001 as a partnership between Dale Schmidt and Mainca Equipamentos Carnicos S.L. of Barcelona Spain to help expand Mainca’s North American distribution of quality meat and food processing equipment. With Dale’s 25 years of experience working for and managing the Schmidt family’s meat processing equipment distribution company (founded in 1942), it was a natural progression for Dale to move into the importation and distribution business. From then on, Mainca USA was immediately ready to provide the finest in quality equipment to the industry Dale knows best.
industries_served: Quality Equipment for the Meat & Food Processing Industry
